data.name: Hufaazah
data.gender_notes: Hufaazah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A Hufaazah is a person who has memorized the entire Quran, considered a high honor in Islamic tradition. The name Hufaazah carries the meaning “Guardian of the Quran” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Hufaazah usually hope their child will grow to embody guardian of the quran and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Being a Hufaazah signifies deep commitment and dedication towards the Quran and its teachings.
data.etymology: Hufaazah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guardian of the Quran.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hufaazah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_english.name: Hufaazah
in_english.long_meaning: Hufaazah is a name derived from the Arabic root hifz, meaning to preserve and protect, a concept important in Islam where it refers to the preservation of the Quran and Sunnah, as well as the protection of faith and Islamic traditions

Memorizing the entire Quran is a tremendous accomplishment that requires immense dedication, discipline, and focus. Hufaazahs are revered figures in their communities, known for their knowledge, piety, and devotion to the sacred text. Their contribution to Islamic heritage is immeasurable, as they preserve and transmit the Quran orally, ensuring its accuracy and authenticity for future generations.

By dedicating their lives to memorizing and reciting God’s words, Hufaazahs strive to embody the essence of Islamic reverence and obedience. Their pursuit of knowledge and commitment to preserving the Quran reflects their deep faith and trust in God's wisdom and guidance. Becoming a Hufaazah symbolizes a personal connection with the divine text, marking a journey towards greater spiritual growth and closeness to Allah SWT.
